context: Evaluates: Design a Use Case with Input/Output Ports

checklist.name: Input port interface defined: register-user.ts defines
checklist.description: **Input port interface defined**: `register-user.ts` defines a typed input interface (e.g. `RegisterUserInput`) with `email`, `password`, and `name` — no `req`/`res` objects

checklist.name: Output port interface defined: register-user.ts defines
checklist.description: **Output port interface defined**: `register-user.ts` defines a typed output interface (e.g. `RegisterUserOutput`) with `userId` and `email` — no HTTP response formatting

checklist.name: Use case depends on repository interface:
checklist.description: **Use case depends on repository interface**: `register-user.ts` receives a user repository through an interface (`IUserRepository` or similar), not the concrete `UserRepository` class

checklist.name: No HTTP/Express imports in use case:
checklist.description: **No HTTP/Express imports in use case**: `register-user.ts` has no imports from `express` and no `req` or `res` parameters — HTTP concerns are removed

checklist.name: DESIGN.md explains layer placement: DESIGN.md identifies
checklist.description: **DESIGN.md explains layer placement**: DESIGN.md identifies at least: use case in application layer, repository interface in application layer, HTTP adapter in adapter layer
